title: Ice hockey governing body website defaced by hackers amid dispute over Russia's exclusion
hint: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) confirmed a cyberattack on its website after hackers replaced its homepage with a pro-Russian message criticizing the country's exclusion from international competitions.

title: Major Brazilian Signature Apps Enable RCE & Fraud
